title: Circle Pattern Theorem for Quasi-simplicial Triangulated Surfaces
summary: The Circle Pattern Theorem characterizes the existence and rigidity of circle patterns with prescribed intersection angles on simplicial triangulations of closed surfaces. In this paper we extend the theorem to quasi-simplicial triangulations -- triangulations that may contain loops and multiple edges, but whose lifts to the universal cover are simplicial.
